newsitem.title: USA: National Record June same-store sale rise.
newsitem.headline: National Record June same-store sale rise.

text.p: National Record Mart Inc said Thursday that its comparable store sales in June, for shops open for at least one year, were up 10.9 percent, compared with the same month in 1996.
Total sales for the latest month increased 8.5 percent compared with the same period the year before with fewer stores.
National Record Mart is a specialty retailer of pre-recorded music and entertainment products which currently operates 144 stores.
